blocks.html: Reading showcase

A page of everything the reading view draws. It links to the guide, to a missing page and to a section. Code references open in your editor: src/main.rs:12, and plain text like src/main.rs:3 works too.
Text and lists
Paragraphs keep a comfortable measure at any zoom: emphasis, inline code, strike, a footnote1 and an autolink https://example.com. Press Ctrl+F to find in page.

• Render Markdown
  • Keep my place when the file changes
  • Review the changes

Note

Alerts come with a title and an icon.

Warning

Reading is the main mode. Beautiful, clear reading is a requirement.

fn main() {
    let name = "PerMark";
    println!("Hello, {name}!");
}

blocks.html: Guide
Back to the readme. More ideas in ideas.
Getting started
Open a folder, pick a document in the tree, read it. Links between documents work like a wiki: use Alt+Left to go back.
Shortcuts

Keys Action
Ctrl+F Find in page
Alt+Left Back
Ctrl+= / Ctrl+- Zoom
Handbook
A long document to read: chapters, sections, lists, a table and code. Scroll it, use the outline, jump between sections.

Install the app
This section explains install the app. The page keeps your place when you come back to it. You can undo the last change with Ctrl+Z.

A short note at the bottom of the window tells you when something is done. Settings for this live in the Settings page, under the section with the same name. If something does not look right, close the document and open it again.
